Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 packet and next steps from today's call

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our call, attached is the SOC 2 Type II packet and a short security overview that covers our encryption, key management, and subprocessors. Quick summary of what I attached:

- SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025-TypeII.pdf — full attestation and control mapping
- redwood-security-overview.pdf — one-page summary of network and data protections

Next steps we suggested on the call:
1) Your security team reviews the SOC 2 report and shares any questions or blockers
2) If helpful, a 30-minute follow-up with Rishi (cc'd) to walk through technical details
3) Decision on procurement timeline (target date you mentioned: end of July)

Please let me know if you need anything else from our side — happy to get a tailored control narrative or redline a DPA if that helps speed review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025-TypeII.pdf, redwood-security-overview.pdf

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@fintechco.com>

Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 packet and next steps from today's call

Thanks Marissa — I got the packet and started a first-pass review. A couple things on our checklist:

- Can you confirm the list of subprocessors and whether any access to customer data is non-production?
- We need an encryption-at-rest diagram (high level) and the KMS provider for key lifecycle details
- Do you have an up-to-date list of penetration tests and results for 2025?

Our target is to complete the security review by July 22 so we can move to procurement in early August. If you can share the items above (or set up a quick call with your infra team), that would be great.

Cheers,
Jane
Senior Information Security Manager
FinTechCo
